utterances.text: I have no further questions, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE RODRIGUES
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you very much, Mr. Saxon. Mr. Simic, any additional questions? MR. K. SIMIC: [Interpretation] Just one, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE RODRIGUES
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Please proceed. MR. K. SIMIC: [Interpretation] Thank you, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: MR. K
utterances.text: Mr. Rosic, I omitted to ask you one thing. You said that the team, first aid team that came to help, that you knew somebody amongst that team. Could you tell us that person's name, whether it be male or female?

utterances.speaker: MILENKO ROSIC
utterances.text: The name was Ljuban Andzic. MR. K. SIMIC: [Interpretation] Thank you, Your Honours. I have no further questions.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE RODRIGUES
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, Mr. Simic. Judge Riad, any questions? No. Madam Judge Wald, any questions? No.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE RODRIGUES
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I have a question for you, Mr. Rosic, and I'm going to go back to that incident once again. You said that that particular policeman shouted with the other people. Did I understand you correctly?

utterances.speaker: MILENKO ROSIC
utterances.text: I don't quite follow you, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE RODRIGUES
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Did you say, yes or no, that that policeman was shouting, that he was shouting in the direction of some other people?

utterances.speaker: MILENKO ROSIC
utterances.text: He shouted and rushed to the administration building and asked for an ambulance to be called.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE RODRIGUES
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Who did he ask to call an ambulance?

utterances.speaker: MILENKO ROSIC
utterances.text: I don't know because I don't know those people, whether it was the employees of the mine or whether he asked the other people who were giving security.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE RODRIGUES
utterances.text: [Interpretation] But these people, were they wearing civilian clothes, or were they in uniform?

utterances.speaker: MILENKO ROSIC
utterances.text: Well, both. They were in civilian clothing, in military uniforms, and police uniforms. So there were policemen and there were people wearing army uniforms as well, and civilian clothing.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE RODRIGUES
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Another question, Mr. Rosic. You said that the shooting lasted several seconds. Could you tell me, and I know that everything which has to do with distance, quality, time, and so on, it's always difficult to give an exact estimation, but I will nonetheless ask you the following question: Could you tell us more or less approximately what space of time went by between the end of the shooting and the arrival of that policeman?

utterances.speaker: MILENKO ROSIC
utterances.text: It was just a few seconds. I can't tell you exactly, but it was precisely at that moment, just a few seconds.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE RODRIGUES
utterances.text: [Interpretation] If I understood you correctly, after the shooting you stayed for another five or ten minutes. Did I hear you say that?

utterances.speaker: MILENKO ROSIC
utterances.text: I stayed 15 to 20 minutes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE RODRIGUES
utterances.text: [Interpretation] You mean after the shooting?

utterances.speaker: MILENKO ROSIC
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE RODRIGUES
utterances.text: [Interpretation] When the women came to clean the spot, were you still there when they were cleaning up the blood that had soaked, that had soaked the ground?

utterances.speaker: MILENKO ROSIC
utterances.text: It was after the ambulance had left when they took up all the casualties, all the people who had been injured and wounded.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE RODRIGUES
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Were you present yourself when they cleared up the area?

utterances.speaker: MILENKO ROSIC
utterances.text: Yes. I was getting ready to go home.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE RODRIGUES
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Okay. So if I've understood you correctly, it was the first and only time that you were in the Omarska camp at that time, during that period; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: MILENKO ROSIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE RODRIGUES
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I have another question for you. You spoke about a corner where there were buses bringing civilians. Were you opposite the buses? Were you located opposite the buses?

utterances.speaker: MILENKO ROSIC
utterances.text: I was located in front of the buses, some 25 to 30 metres away in front of the buses.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE RODRIGUES
utterances.text: [Interpretation] So if I understand you correctly, you were in front but towards the left where the entrance to the administration building is located; is that right?

utterances.speaker: MILENKO ROSIC
utterances.text: I was in front, up by the hangar where the dumpers were. Right across you have the administration building, the pista, and then the hangar. I was at the very corner of the hangar building.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE RODRIGUES
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Okay. Very well. Mr. Rosic, we have no further questions to ask you. We thank you very much for coming, and we wish you a good return to your place of residence and every success in your work. I'm now going to ask the usher to escort you out of the courtroom.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you too, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE RODRIGUES
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, Mr. Simic. MR. K. SIMIC: [Interpretation] Your Honour, linked to the testimony of Mr. Branko Rosic and Milenko Rosic, and in view of your suggestions, we would like to notify you that we will, tomorrow, tender for admission medical documents for Mr. Miroslav Nisic, a person who was injured in this terrible and bloody incident, and that we shall also tender medical documentation on the wounding of Mr. Emin Zjakic, a person who was getting off the bus and was involved in this incident. We also wish to notify the Chamber that the statements of Mr. Branko and Milenko Rosic have been corroborated with affidavits of Miroslav Misic, a person who was seriously wounded in both legs in this incident. Also, I must admit that we had not planned any additional witnesses. We thought three would be enough. So we miscalculated by about 15 minutes. So we have no more witnesses for today.
